title: AI Keyframe Music Video 🎶 Surreal MidJourney x Pika
description:
A surreal AI music video built from keyframes—images in MidJourney, animated for flow and rhythm. It’s a trippy, high-energy ride.

Tools: MidJourney (+ keyframe animation). Comment your favorite moment & subscribe for the next drop.

I was testing out #Midjourney style ref codes and really love this one. Made some DJs and animated them using Pika_labs #pikaframes. Song made using Suno. It’s called In This Moment. 

#AI #AIArt #AIVideo #AIMusic #AIImages #AIArtwork  
#AIAnimation #Keyframes #MidJourney #Pika #Suno #KellyBoesch
